full_judgment: 2. Defendants 1-7 contested the suit by filing a joint written statement in which they denied the material allegations made in the plaint and asserted their own right, title and possession in the suit land. Their case inter alia was that the suit land was the khas land of the landlords who settled 5'75 acres with the mother of defendant No. 1, 3'60 acres with Habizuddin and '72 acres with Shamsuddin and others and 72 acres with Riazuddin in 1337 B. S. and the balance of 1'56 acres was still in the khas possession of the landlords. Defendants further asserted that they have been in possession since the tulle of their settlement and that they had grown the paddy in the suit land and reaped it away.
